01

“birds in flocks (ababil)”

Eight explanations transmitted from ʿIkrima, Mujāhid ibn Jabr and ʿUbayd ibn ʿUmayr al-Laythī (Q 105:3).

01
Explanation from ʿIkrima 01

ʿIkrima

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Shayban narrated to us, from Jabir, from ʿIkrima:
birds in flocks (ababil) [al-Fil: 3], meaning: “in groups, group after group.” Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Shayban narrated to us, from Jabir, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sabit, who said: “meaning the numerous.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ:
طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ [الفيل: 3] ، يَعْنِي: «زُمَرًا زُمَرًا» . أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَابِطٍ، قَالَ: «يَعْنِي الْكَثِيرَةَ»
Edition record 373918 · p. 749Link to report ↗
02
Report from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
“birds in flocks (ababil),” meaning: “they were of various kinds, gathered together, following one another.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ، يَعْنِي:
«هِيَ شَتًّى مُجْتَمِعَةً مُتَتَابِعَةً»
Edition record 373919 · p. 749Link to report ↗
03
Report from ʿUbayd ibn ʿUmayr 03

ʿUbayd ibn ʿUmayr al-Laythī

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Sharik narrated to us, from Jabir, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sabit, from ʿUbayd ibn ʿUmayr al-Laythi, who said:
“The ababil are those that follow one another. The birds came out of the sea looking like Indian men, black, with stones with them — the largest like young adult camels (bazul) and the smallest like men’s heads. They wanted nothing but they struck it, and struck no one but they killed him.” Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Sharik narrated to us, from Jabir, from Mujahid, who said: “They are the ʿanqaʾ mughribah (the legendary far-flying ʿanqaʾ bird).”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَابِطٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ، قَالَ:
" الْأَبَابِيلُ: الْمُتَتَابِعَةُ، خَرَجَتِ الطَّيْرُ مِنَ الْبَحْرِ كَأَنَّهَا أَمْثَالُ رِجَالِ الْهِنْدِ، سُودٌ مَعَهَا حِجَارَةٌ أَعْظَمُهَا أَمْثَالُ الْإِبِلِ الْبُزَّلِ، وَأَصْغَرُهَا أَمْثَالُ رُءُوسِ الرِّجَالِ، لَا تُرِيدُ شَيْئًا إِلَّا أَصَابَتْهُ، وَلَا تُصِيبُ أَحَدًا إِلَّا قَتَلَتْهُ ". أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: «هِيَ الْعَنْقَاءُ الْمُغْرِبَةُ»
Edition record 373920 · p. 749Link to report ↗
04
Report from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Shayban narrated to us, from Jabir, from Mujahid, who said:
“It is the ʿanqaʾ, a bird created for them, never seen before them or after them. It pelted them [p. 750] with small stones, as small as balsam seeds (bulsan), and it struck nothing of them but it [did its work upon it — the Arabic verb, afʿalathu, is as given in the source], until they were exhausted.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
«هِيَ الْعَنْقَاءُ، طَيْرٌ خُلِقَتْ لَهُمْ، لَمْ تُرَ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا بَعْدَهُمْ تَرْمِيهِمْ ⦗ص: 750⦘ بِحِجَارَةٍ صِغَارٍ مِثْلِ الْبُلْسَانِ مِنَ الصِّغَرِ لَا تُصِيبُ مِنْهُمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا أَفْعَلَتْهُ ، حَتَّى يَنْفُدَ»
Edition record 373921 · p. 749Link to report ↗
05
Report from ʿIkrima 05

ʿIkrima

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Shayban narrated to us, from Jabir, from ʿIkrima, who said:
“It is the far-flying ʿanqaʾ; it pelted them with stones the size of a tooth, which came out of its talons and mouths. It struck nothing of them but it pierced it, so that a hundred thousand of them would die in a day.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، قَالَ:
«هِيَ الْعَنْقَاءُ الْمُغْرِبَةُ تَرْمِيهِمْ بِحِجَارَةٍ مِثْلِ السِّنِّ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ مَخَالِبِهَا وَأَفْوَاهِهَا لَا تُصِيبُ مِنْهُمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا خَرَقَتْهُ حَتَّى كَانَ يَمُوتُ مِنْهُمْ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةُ أَلْفٍ»
Edition record 373922 · p. 750Link to report ↗
06
Report from ʿIkrima 06

ʿIkrima

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Sharik narrated to us, from Khusayf, from ʿIkrima, who said:
“They were white birds whose faces were like the faces of beasts of prey.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، قَالَ:
«هِيَ طَيْرٌ بِيضٌ كَأَنَّ وجُوهَهَا وُجُوهُ السِّبَاعِ»
Edition record 373923 · p. 750Link to report ↗
07
Report from ʿIkrima 07

ʿIkrima

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Hammad ibn Salama narrated to us, from Ayyub al-Sakhtiyani and Humayd al-Tawil, from ʿIkrima, who said:
“In Persian it is: sijjil — sank wa-kul [sang-u-gil] — meaning stone and clay.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ قَالَ نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا حَمَّادُ بنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ السِّخْتِيَانِيِّ، وَحُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، قَالَ:
" هِيَ بِالْفَارِسِيَّةِ: سِجِّيلٌ سنك وكل، يَعْنِي حَجَرًا وَطِينًا "
Edition record 373924 · p. 750Link to report ↗
08
Report from ʿIkrima 08

ʿIkrima

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from ʿAta’ ibn al-Sa’ib, from ʿIkrima, who said:
“It is [a word] of Persian and Nabataean.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، قَالَ:
«هِيَ بِالْفَارِسِيَّةِ وَالنَّبَطِيَّةِ»
Edition record 373925 · p. 750Link to report ↗
02

“like eaten straw”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Saʿīd ibn Jubayr (Q 105:5).

09
Explanation from Mujāhid 09

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding His saying:
like eaten straw [al-Fil: 5]: “The ʿasf is the leaf of wheat.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
كَعَصْفٍ مَأْكُولٍ [الفيل: 5] " الْعَصْفُ: وَرَقُ الْحِنْطَةِ "
Edition record 373926 · p. 750Link to report ↗
10
Report from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr 10

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from ʿAta’ ibn al-Sa’ib, from Saʿid ibn Jubayr, who said:
“The ʿasf is the habbūr [a term for crop stalks/fodder; retained as in the source].”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
" الْعَصْفُ: هُوَ الْهَبُّورُ "
Edition record 373927 · p. 751Link to report ↗
